claim.success: usable threshold-reaching material for the pinned committee, event, and validity interval

bridgeGates.name: usable-delivery-completeness
bridgeGates.question: Does every counted artifact satisfy a pinned usable-material predicate, and does every covered success contain a threshold-reaching covered delivery?
acceptedEvidence: pinned verifier plus entry-complete success mapping

bridgeGates.name: acquirer-funding
bridgeGates.question: Does every counted irreversible debit originate from the named acquiring principal?

bridgeGates.name: delivery-payment-atomicity
bridgeGates.question: Is usable delivery impossible before the required debit is irreversible, including failed and reverted paths?
acceptedEvidence: state-machine or contract proof covering all success entries

bridgeGates.name: offset-closure
bridgeGates.question: Are all in-scope refunds, rebates, credits, recoveries, reimbursements, circular transfers, and controlled-party returns closed or subtracted?
acceptedEvidence: closed accounting graph with upper bounds
enforceable scope statement plus verifier output

bridgeGates.name: alternative-route-closure
bridgeGates.question: Does every successful route in the claimed mechanism language map to the checked transition, and are excluded languages named?
acceptedEvidence: entry and upgrade closure plus explicit off-chain boundary

baselines.slashing-only: may certify member loss; zero attacker-payment certificate without B1-B5
baselines.self-reported-price: zero robust floor unless independently made binding
baselines.bridge-qualified: positive only for the exact admitted mechanism language

decisionRule.positiveMechanismConditionalPayment: all B1-B5 pass under one scope and a positive net debit floor is proved
decisionRule.positiveDeploymentWidePayment: every allowed acquisition language passes or is excluded by binding evidence
decisionRule.missingOrAmbiguous: fail closed to zero and emit explicit rejection reasons
decisionRule.zeroInterpretation: public evidence does not rule out a zero-payment compatible world; it is not an insecurity or behavior claim
